Violin Plots

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/violin.Rmd
violin.Rmd

Basic Violin Plot 

library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/violin_data.csv")

df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_violin(
    y = ~total_bill,
    box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
    meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
    x0 = "Total Bill"
  ) |>
  update_layout(yaxis = go_yaxis(title = "", zeroline = FALSE))

Multiple Trace 

library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/violin_data.csv")

# one violin per day, in the order the days appear in the data
df |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_violin(
    x = ~day,
    y = ~total_bill,
    split = ~factor(day, levels = unique(day)),
    box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
    meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE)
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(title = "Day"),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(title = "Total Bill", zeroline = FALSE)
  )

Grouped Violin Plot 

library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/violin_data.csv")

go_figure() |>
  add_violin(
    data = df[df$sex == "Male", ],
    x = ~day,
    y = ~total_bill,
    legendgroup = "M",
    scalegroup = "M",
    name = "M",
    box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
    meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
    line = go_violin_line(color = "blue")
  ) |>
  add_violin(
    data = df[df$sex == "Female", ],
    x = ~day,
    y = ~total_bill,
    legendgroup = "F",
    scalegroup = "F",
    name = "F",
    box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
    meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
    line = go_violin_line(color = "pink")
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    yaxis = go_yaxis(zeroline = FALSE),
    violinmode = "group"
  )

Split Violin Plot 

library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/violin_data.csv")

go_figure() |>
  add_violin(
    data = df[df$smoker == "Yes", ],
    x = ~day,
    y = ~total_bill,
    legendgroup = "Yes",
    scalegroup = "Yes",
    name = "Yes",
    side = "negative",
    box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
    meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
    line = go_violin_line(color = "blue")
  ) |>
  add_violin(
    data = df[df$smoker == "No", ],
    x = ~day,
    y = ~total_bill,
    legendgroup = "No",
    scalegroup = "No",
    name = "No",
    side = "positive",
    box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
    meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
    line = go_violin_line(color = "green")
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(title = ""),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(title = "", zeroline = FALSE),
    violingap = 0,
    violingroupgap = 0,
    violinmode = "overlay"
  )

Advanced Violin Plot 

library(plotly.core)

df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/violin_data.csv")

pointposMale <- c(-0.9, -1.1, -0.6, -0.3)
pointposFemale <- c(0.45, 0.55, 1, 0.4)
showLegend <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)

fig <- go_figure()

for (i in seq_along(unique(df$day))) {
  day <- unique(df$day)[i]
  fig <- fig |>
    add_violin(
      x = df$day[df$sex == "Male" & df$day == day],
      y = df$total_bill[df$sex == "Male" & df$day == day],
      hoveron = "points+kde",
      legendgroup = "M",
      scalegroup = "M",
      name = "M",
      side = "negative",
      box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
      points = "all",
      pointpos = pointposMale[i],
      jitter = 0,
      scalemode = "count",
      meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
      line = go_violin_line(color = "#8dd3c7"),
      marker = go_violin_marker(
        line = go_violin_marker_line(width = 2, color = "#8dd3c7"),
        symbol = "line-ns"
      ),
      showlegend = showLegend[i]
    ) |>
    add_violin(
      x = df$day[df$sex == "Female" & df$day == day],
      y = df$total_bill[df$sex == "Female" & df$day == day],
      hoveron = "points+kde",
      legendgroup = "F",
      scalegroup = "F",
      name = "F",
      side = "positive",
      box = go_violin_box(visible = TRUE),
      points = "all",
      pointpos = pointposFemale[i],
      jitter = 0,
      scalemode = "count",
      meanline = go_violin_meanline(visible = TRUE),
      line = go_violin_line(color = "#bebada"),
      marker = go_violin_marker(
        line = go_violin_marker_line(width = 2, color = "#bebada"),
        symbol = "line-ns"
      ),
      showlegend = showLegend[i]
    )
}

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Total bill distribution<br><i>scaled by number of bills per gender",
    yaxis = go_yaxis(zeroline = FALSE),
    violingap = 0,
    violingroupgap = 0,
    violinmode = "overlay",
    legend = go_legend(tracegroupgap = 0)
  )

fig
